rules.description: Named project, working directory, Git root, and loaded instructions must all identify canonical Reiyah.
A scientific object payload may not impersonate another scientific kind.
Missing may not be emitted as an observed value or confident default.
Unmeasured may not be emitted as an observed or imputed value.
Out-of-distribution may not become a confident in-distribution output.
Sensor-invalid may not become an observed last-known or default value.
Abstained may not become an observed default action or label.
Out-of-distribution, sensor-invalid, and abstained measurements must name the exact governing boundary, validity, or abstention rule.
Lifecycle status must use the complete closed vocabulary.
Lifecycle histories may not contain a transition forbidden by the minimum Gate A transition model.
Every experiment and result must retain a nonempty legal lifecycle history whose final event equals its current status.
Lifecycle-history event times must be exact UTC timestamps and strictly increase in stored order.
An information-set input must be available no later than its index time.
Every normative scientific record must retain provenance.
Declared SHA-256 must match exact retained bytes.
Every internal object reference must resolve by identifier and version.
A resolved internal reference must have its declared and expected kind.
Every typed scientific edge must preserve its declared encounter, physical-object, protocol, and time context.
Corrected and replicated results must bind a distinct, existing result predecessor with an admissible relation.
A retained artifact reference must resolve to exact indexed repository bytes with matching identity, version, and digest.
A release binding must not transfer to changed manifest bytes.
One released identifier may not bind multiple byte identities.
Mission and protocol releases must form same-kind acyclic append-only histories whose ledger state and relation exactly match the bound manifest.
Observed and every non-observed state count must reconcile to the eligible denominator.
Every result metric must use a decision rule and abstention rule declared by its exact experiment version.
Every protocol-governed construct, rule, method, state space, choice set, outcome, group, and analysis identifier must resolve by type and version in the exact protocol-owned registry.
Every preregistered group must have a result or explicit unknown disposition.
Validation may depend only on repository bytes, interpreter, and local schema library.
A standards mapping may not claim compliance and must expose exact retained evidence fields.
Operator acceptance must be authorized and bind the current architecture-complete index digest.
Gate A fixtures may not contain private, secret, operational, or real records.
Gate A may contain static architecture and offline validation capabilities only.
The canonical mission, scientific charter, and prohibited-scope boundary must be present and mutually consistent.
Narrative and machine-readable claim/non-claim identifiers and counts must match exactly.
Every observed probability-vector latent belief must normalize to one within its declared tolerance.
An evidentiary lifecycle disposition requires retained, source-ledger-resolved evidence; support-like dispositions also require valid evidence.

A retained claim, experiment, result, metric, or status-history binding must resolve to an eligible evidence object with a retained, source-ledger-resolved basis; support-like dispositions also require valid evidence.
Every file under evidence/sources must be declared exactly once by the source ledger and retain inert allowed media.
Every declared threat must retain mitigations, detection evidence, residual risk, and validation-plan traceability.
An architecture-complete validation report must equal a fresh canonical full run and retain complete schema, fixture, source, instance, and index coverage.
Every acyclic index exclusion accepts only its exact authorized artifact class and may not hide arbitrary code, data, or metadata.
The stored index must equal the complete canonical builder object and every indexed artifact must carry an explicit version.
Operator decisions must form one unique chronological append-only supersession chain with no duplicate identities, branches, cycles, or conflicting heads.
The Gate A index must exclude itself, its sidecar, reports, decisions, and transient metadata.
A frozen analysis specification must be internally unique and preserve exact membership, policy, protocol-estimand, and primary-metric parity before any result exists.
Every observed categorical belief must use the exact normalization tolerance owned by its digest-bound protocol release.
A protocol evidence-binding policy must preserve the exact Gate A active, disallowed, terminal, support-like, and witness-status contract.
Every evidence-governed terminal disposition must retain the protocol-required number of exact, reciprocal, active, and disposition-compatible evidence witnesses.

Every indexed production path must have the exact canonical role, media type, typed schema identity, and ledger or fixture ownership required for that path; published history prefixes are closed to their declared snapshots.
Each normative narrative must match both its exact validation-plan digest binding and the stable semantic identities and fields in its machine-readable counterpart.
A preregistration freeze, registration, lifecycle event, and observation-boundary opening must be exact UTC instants in the required nondecreasing and strictly pre-boundary order.
A preregistered experiment must exactly equal its typed retained analysis and observation-boundary freeze surfaces.
Scientific and evidence dependency references must form globally acyclic exact-version graphs.
A downstream outcome must explicitly retain every exact decision dependency carried through its intervention references.
A scientific-disposition result must bind the exact current eligible experiment head under the protocol-owned result-binding policy, including required running history.
Every result metric must exactly match its experiment, protocol estimand, and frozen analysis fields, policies, uncertainty method, and confidence level.
A result lifecycle must equal its exact primary metric-derived disposition, and embedded metrics may not assert record-lineage-only statuses.
Every non-result scientific logical record must form one immutable, exact-version, append-only, unbranched root-to-current-head history.
Every non-gap standards mapping must bind unique retained sources and observed exact version, publication date, scope, comparator, and requirement locator.
Every standards-crosswalk mapping identifier must be present and globally unique.
Every experiment must declare unique boundaries covering exactly population, object, time, sensor, reference, support, and protocol.
A worst-group disposition must select every direction-aware tied eligible extremum and may not assert an observed winner when group information is incomplete.
Normative JSON must reject non-finite numeric tokens such as NaN and Infinity before schema or semantic interpretation.
Normative JSON must reject duplicate object member names before last-value parser semantics can conceal a conflicting value.
Belief holder, target, information availability, decision authority, readiness, and recoverability must remain typed, temporally reconciled, and explicit about unknowns.
Joint performance, silent misses, selective/OOD/conformal behavior, transfer, and worst-group results must share exact opportunity and arithmetic contracts.
Study preregistration, power, stopping, causal DAG, missingness, data splits, access chronology, and deviations must remain frozen and internally coherent.
Sequential OPE must bind exact policies, trajectories, propensities, support, weights, ESS, horizon, rewards, costs, constraints, and estimators without extrapolation.
Dataset, ODD, scenario, test, benchmark, and static safety-argument interfaces must preserve provenance, leakage, unknown, oracle, proposed-only, no-deployment, and no-compliance boundaries.
Every required property exercised by a valid Gate A 1.1 scientific-contract application must reject under deterministic removal using the resolved production schema registry.
The exact eight-schema, five-application Gate A 1.1 scientific-contract package, fixture bindings, production rules, and RGA closure evidence must remain complete and non-authoritative.

Every Gate A 1.1 reference-bearing surface must have exactly one declared owner class and resolve with exact identity, kind, version, and cardinality or an explicit non-authoritative unavailable disposition.

The public custody graph must exactly partition the active source ledger into four retained redistributable ISO payloads and four pointer-only records, with versioned append-only rights observations, exact receipt lineage, and non-authority bindings.

Each excluded post-push receipt must use its event-specific schema, bind the exact immediate prior receipt plus packet index, validation report, and fresh rights bytes, preserve the exact-four-payload boundary, and create no acceptance or runtime authority.

Historical Gate A recovery must exactly bind predecessor index, sidecar, report, recovered bytes, sizes, and path-specific recovery classes while disclosing interrupted custody and no prior acceptance.
The research-function registry must have unique contiguous sequence, exact acyclic dependency order, resolved local contracts, and compatible producer-consumer handoffs.

Each versioned operator-decision schema and deliberately invalid template must remain synthetically satisfiable against the exact unchanged release ledger and its own frozen or current packet index/report identities without authenticating authority or evaluating GA-17.
Released Gate A 1.1.0 and 1.1.1 packet bytes outside their explicit successor surfaces, including each frozen report, must remain byte-exact against the preserved predecessor indexes.

Exact Gate A 1.1 scientific-contract package and exhaustive typed reference ownership

Versioned, ledger-exact, non-authoritative operator-decision satisfiability and replay
